cohort: Inborn babies between 26 and 34 weeks gestation who were managed for RDS with CPAP alone or with additional surfactant.
finding: The use of CPAP and surfactant was effective in reducing morbidity and mortality among very low birth weight babies.
birth_weight: Mean 1.35 kg (+/-0.322 kg); including extremely low birth weight (11.5%), very low birth weight (55.8%) and low birth weight (32.7%) infants.
